svg.aria-label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash CSA2: local and compressed KV share a softmax schematic
svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — CSA2: local and compressed KV share a softmax
svg.desc: Gather a causal local window and the published compressed indices, then normalize them together with the learned sink logit. The sink contributes denominator mass and no value. A CPU experiment holds the selected dictionary fixed and changes only the query to expose different weights and readouts. Authored adaptation of DeepSeek publisher code (MIT). Dense reference of the sparse attention core only: FP32 accumulation with query-dtype output. Queries and shared K/V latents are already projected, normalized and rotated. selected contains causal compressed indices or -1; Full/Reindex publish them and Reuse reads them unchanged. Local history uses absolute positions instead of a ring buffer. The fixed-dictionary experiment compares alternative queries at the same position; it does not represent successive layers or tokens. Real layers retain fresh local KV, query and output projections. Inverse output RoPE, grouped output projections and quantization are outside this excerpt. Publisher mapping is not production certification.
